Bitcoin-proxy equities like MSTR will keep decoupling from fundamentals, creating recurring arbitrage for traders but no durable sector alpha for allocators.
sectors.ai: Buy US-listed AI/software names (PLTR, ORCL, NOW) on relative strength versus Jakarta tech; MSTR's BTC-linked surge is a momentum trade, not a core hold. Rotate ID exposure into RUNS/YELO only for short-term liquidity plays. Expect US mega-cap software to keep outperforming Indonesian tech until rupiah stabilizes and local earnings revisions turn positive.

Infrastructure aggregates remain range-bound; overweight ID names with domestic revenue, underweight US-linked plays until rate clarity improves.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Structural adoption of proof-of-stake and utility chains (ADA, ARB) continues to outpace pure speculative assets, anchoring institutional inflows as staking yields and real DeFi usage compound.

Meme and political tokens (PEPE, TRUMP) remain high-beta liquidity magnets, but their sustainability hinges on retail sentiment cycles, making them tactical trades rather than core holdings.
sectors.ai: Buy the crypto complex on momentum, but rotate into liquid large-caps (ADA, ARB) and privacy/utility names (ZEC, LIT) over meme exposure (PEPE, TRUMP) which is frothier. The +3.71% aggregate with broad double-digit movers signals risk-on re-acceleration, not a one-off bounce. For Indonesia exposure, ride via global proxies (exchange tokens, DeFi) since local regulatory clarity lags; take profits into any 48-hour parabolic extension above +20% per name.
